title: Aerospace employee with an object moving in their body

tellings.quote: there's a a person at one of the Aerospace corporations I cannot say their name because I don't want to get them any kind of trouble but they've had something moving in their body now for several years

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says he knows of a person working at one of the big aerospace companies who has had something moving inside their body for several years. He says he will not give the name to keep the person out of trouble. He tells it as a possible sign of a strange encounter that left a physical trace.
